description: This file defines inline functions for performing various types of fast Fourier transforms (FFT) and related operations within the torch::fft namespace, primarily wrapping calls to lower-level implementation functions and providing a C++ interface consistent with PyTorch's FFT functionalities.

methods.name: Tensor fft(const Tensor & self,std::optional<SymInt> n=std::nullopt,int64_t dim=-1,std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs a 1D FFT over a tensor along a specified dimension, with optional size and normalization.

methods.name: Tensor ifft(const Tensor & self,std::optional<SymInt> n=std::nullopt,int64_t dim=-1,std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs a 1D inverse FFT over a tensor along a specified dimension, with optional size and normalization.

methods.name: Tensor fft2(const Tensor & self,OptionalIntArrayRef s=std::nullopt,IntArrayRef dim={-2, -1},std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs a 2D FFT over a tensor with optional sides and normalization.

methods.name: Tensor ifft2(const Tensor & self,at::OptionalIntArrayRef s=std::nullopt,IntArrayRef dim={-2, -1},std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs a 2D inverse FFT over a tensor with optional sides and normalization.

methods.name: Tensor fftn(const Tensor & self,at::OptionalIntArrayRef s=std::nullopt,at::OptionalIntArrayRef dim=std::nullopt,std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs an N-dimensional FFT over a tensor with optional sides, dimensions, and normalization.

methods.name: Tensor ifftn(const Tensor & self,at::OptionalIntArrayRef s=std::nullopt,at::OptionalIntArrayRef dim=std::nullopt,std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs an N-dimensional inverse FFT over a tensor with optional sides, dimensions, and normalization.

methods.name: Tensor rfft(const Tensor & self,std::optional<SymInt> n=std::nullopt,int64_t dim=-1,std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs a real-input 1D FFT with positive frequency output for a tensor.

methods.name: Tensor irfft(const Tensor & self,std::optional<SymInt> n=std::nullopt,int64_t dim=-1,std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs an inverse real-input FFT, converting Hermitian inputs to real output.

methods.name: Tensor rfft2(const Tensor & self,at::OptionalIntArrayRef s=std::nullopt,IntArrayRef dim={-2, -1},std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs a real-input 2D FFT, returning a Hermitian symmetric output.

methods.name: Tensor irfft2(const Tensor & self,at::OptionalIntArrayRef s=std::nullopt,IntArrayRef dim={-2, -1},std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs a 2D inverse FFT for a Hermitian symmetric input, returning a real tensor.

methods.name: Tensor rfftn(const Tensor & self,at::OptionalIntArrayRef s=std::nullopt,at::OptionalIntArrayRef dim=std::nullopt,std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs an N-dimensional real-input FFT with Hermitian output.

methods.name: Tensor irfftn(const Tensor & self,at::OptionalIntArrayRef s=std::nullopt,at::OptionalIntArrayRef dim=std::nullopt,std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs an N-dimensional inverse FFT for a Hermitian symmetric input.

methods.name: Tensor hfft(const Tensor & self,std::optional<SymInt> n=std::nullopt,int64_t dim=-1,std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs a 1D Hermitian FFT for a real input with positive frequency output.

methods.name: Tensor ihfft(const Tensor & self,std::optional<SymInt> n=std::nullopt,int64_t dim=-1,std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs an inverse 1D Hermitian FFT for a Hermitian input, producing real output.

methods.name: Tensor hfft2(const Tensor & self,at::OptionalIntArrayRef s=std::nullopt,IntArrayRef dim={-2, -1},std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs a 2D Hermitian FFT, starting from a Hermitian symmetric input.

methods.name: Tensor ihfft2(const Tensor & self,at::OptionalIntArrayRef s=std::nullopt,IntArrayRef dim={-2, -1},std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Inverse 2D Hermitian FFT returning a Hermitian symmetric output.

methods.name: Tensor hfftn(const Tensor & self,at::OptionalIntArrayRef s=std::nullopt,IntArrayRef dim={-2, -1},std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs an N-dimensional Hermitian FFT from a Hermitian input.

methods.name: Tensor ihfftn(const Tensor & self,at::OptionalIntArrayRef s=std::nullopt,IntArrayRef dim={-2, -1},std::optional<std::string_view> norm=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Performs the inverse of the above, returning a Hermitian symmetric input.

methods.name: Tensor fftfreq(int64_t n,const TensorOptions & options={})
methods.description: Returns the discrete Fourier Transform sample frequencies for a signal of size n.

methods.name: Tensor rfftfreq(int64_t n,const TensorOptions & options)
methods.description: Returns the sample frequencies for rfft with a signal of size n.

methods.name: Tensor fftshift(const Tensor & x,at::OptionalIntArrayRef dim=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Rearranges a tensor to shift zero frequency components to the center of the spectrum.

methods.name: Tensor ifftshift(const Tensor & x,at::OptionalIntArrayRef dim=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Inverse of fftshift, restoring the original order.
